process.title: Clarity from the start,
process.desc: Six thoughtful steps to keep budget, dimensions, and project timeline precisely on track

steps.title: Estimate your kitchen set transparently
steps.text: Per linear meter, five classes, fixed price.

steps.title: Design finalized before production
steps.text: Clients review and refine the full design visualization before manufacturing begins.

steps.title: Measured twice
steps.text: Initial estimate based on your provided dimensions, followed by thorough on-site measurements before fabrication.

steps.title: Written timeline as a firm commitment
steps.text: Design phase ~7 working days; room fabrication 30 working days once design is approved.

steps.title: Pricing includes full installation
steps.text: Any item calculated separately is transparently stated upfront (countertop, backsplash, lighting, delivery).

steps.title: Unified with Madina Build
steps.text: Interior can be conceived seamlessly alongside architecture, preventing costly retrofits.

principles.title: Five space standards we apply in every project

items.title: Taharah (Purity & Cleanliness)
items.text: Practical ablution areas and washbasins, easy-to-clean kitchen surfaces, discreet closed storage

items.title: Mahram & Privacy
items.text: Thoughtful zoning between guest reception and private family areas; separate bedrooms for boys and girls

items.title: Facilitating Worship
items.text: Dedicated prayer corner aligned with the Qibla, integrated storage for prayer garments and mats

items.title: Enduring & Quality Materials
items.text: Safe, sustainable, long-lasting materials with detailed specifications stated from day one

items.title: Tawazun (Balance & Moderation)
items.text: Functionality first, unpretentious elegance, tailored strictly to real needs and sensible budgets

about.title: Design, workshop, and installation
about.p1: RUANG MADINA is the interior and custom furniture division of PT Madina Build International, based in Sidoarjo. We handle 3D design planning, in-house cabinet fabrication at our workshop, and on-site installation.
about.p2: By integrating interior work and construction under one team, residential, commercial, and villa projects stay coordinated from the start without costly architectural rework.
